system.description:
Flurry Technique

Once per turn, as a reaction to a creature scoring a hit against you, you can spend 1 Discipline, defending yourself in a manner of your description. You gain a rank of mastery to your AC against the triggering attack until the end of the current turn.

Alternatively, as a reaction to a creature scoring a critical hit against you, you can spend 3 Discipline, defending yourself in a manner of your description. You turn that critical hit, into a normal hit.
